Record chart-review decisions on a pull

Source: R/master_review.R
apply_review.Rd

Reads a decisions file with one row per entry of review_list(): cohort_unit, criterion_id, outcome ("met" or "not_met") and reason_code. An outcome that excludes the unit (not met on an include criterion, or met on an exclude criterion) needs a code from reason_codes. Codes, never free text: chart notes are PHI.

Usage

apply_review(pull, path, reason_codes)

Arguments

pull

A master_pull awaiting review.

path

Character. The decisions file, as CSV.

reason_codes

Character. The study's declared reason codes.

Value

The master_pull, with the review stages appended and data filtered.

Details

A routed unit is settled at the criterion that routed it, so the stage counts stay sequential: if review excludes it, the exclusion is recorded at that criterion and no later stage counts the unit, whether or not a later criterion also excluded it; if review keeps it, every later outcome stands. The criterion's provenance records how many were excluded at review and the decisions file's checksum. Each review criterion is then its own stage, with source review. The file's SHA-256 is recorded in the pull's metadata, and the pull is then complete.

Each later criterion's tally of met, not met and undetermined units is rebuilt from the units that reached it, using the outcomes pull_master() keeps in review$outcomes. A pull saved before that field existed has none, so decisions that would change a counted stage are refused with an error of class hvtiRdatabuild_review_outcomes_missing: pull again with pull_master() and apply the decisions to the new pull. Decisions that change no counted stage are applied as usual.

See also

review_list(), review_criterion()

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("duckdb", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Synthetic data; no PHI.
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo", data.frame(
    mrn = c("SYN101", "SYN102"),
    encounter_date = as.Date(c("2010-03-01", "2012-07-15")),
    proc = c("CABG", "CABG"), age = c(62, 70)
  ))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_corrections_applied", data.frame(
    correction_id = character(), mrn = character(), encounter_date = as.Date(character())
  ))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_deployment", data.frame(sql_commit = "abc1234"))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_parity", data.frame(
    sql_commit = "abc1234", verdict = "pass", verified_at = Sys.time()
  ))
  config <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml")
  writeLines("study: st0000", config)
  strategy <- review_criterion("strategy", "Planned alternative support", role = "exclude")
  q <- cohort_query("proc = 'CABG'", as.Date(c("2000-01-01", "2024-07-31")),
                    criteria = list(strategy), index_on = "qualifying")
  pull <- pull_master(con, "master_demo", q, var_cols = "age", path = config,
                      dialect = "duckdb")
  DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

  # One decision per row of the review list, with a declared code for each exclusion.
  decisions <- review_list(pull)
  decisions$outcome <- c("not_met", "met")
  decisions$reason_code <- c(NA, "PLANNED")
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
  utils::write.csv(decisions, f, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  reviewed <- apply_review(pull, f, reason_codes = "PLANNED")
  reviewed$meta$status
}
